environment.description: Same application deployed behind AWS API Gateway (HTTP API type) with a custom request validator attached to the POST /graphql route. The validator uses a JSON Schema model that enforces: (1) the 'query' field must match a regex pattern ^[a-zA-Z0-9\s\{\}\(\)\:!@_,\.\-]+$ which permits only alphanumeric characters, whitespace, and GraphQL structural characters but rejects single quotes, double-dashes, semicolons, UNION keyword patterns, and comment sequences; (2) the 'variables' object values for string types are constrained to maxLength of 128 and pattern ^[a-zA-Z0-9@\.\-_\s]+$ excluding SQL metacharacters. Request validation is set to 'Validate body' mode. Requests failing validation receive 400 before reaching the origin.

config.api_gateway: AWS API Gateway HTTP API with route POST /graphql
config.request_validation: JSON Schema model on request body with regex constraints on 'query' and 'variables' string fields
config.rejection_behavior: 400 Bad Request before forwarding to integration
